genre.puzzle.h1: Free Puzzle Games and Logic Games
genre.puzzle.titre_seo: Free Puzzle Games | Free Micro Games
genre.puzzle.description_seo: Free puzzle games: 40 brain teasers, mazes and logic grids from age 4, like Robot Max or Horse Sudoku. No sign-up, on phone or PC, and playable offline.
genre.puzzle.intro:
These free puzzle games ask you to think before you tap. In Robot Max, a little robot crosses 24 factory mazes to reach its charging station; in The Water Path, you draw ramps so the water runs into a thirsty glass; Animal Puzzles has 30 pictures to rebuild, from the chick to the peacock. Most levels have no timer, so you can try, get it wrong and try again.

Logic games get trickier as kids grow. Horse Sudoku swaps numbers for eight funny horses, King Barnaby's Scales asks you to balance sacks and gold bars, and Climbing the Peak of the Four Winds, for ages 12 and up, makes you plan a whole route with limited energy. The youngest players, from age 4, start with mazes and pieces to slide; brain games with more steps suit ages 8 to 12.

Stuck on a level? Trace the path with your finger before you move anything. It often shows you the dead end.

faq.q: What age are these puzzle games for?
faq.r: The easiest ones, like Robot Max and The Mouse Maze, work from age 4 or 5. Sudoku, scales and route planning are aimed at kids from 8 up to 12.

faq.q: Do I need an account to play?
faq.r: No. Pick a puzzle and start: there is no account to create and no email address to type in.

faq.q: Can we solve the puzzles without internet?
faq.r: Yes. Open a puzzle once while online and it is saved on the device; after that, the mazes and grids work in airplane mode too.

faq.q: Do the puzzles work on a phone?
faq.r: They are made for touch screens first: Android phones, iPhones and tablets. On a computer, the mouse and keyboard do the same job.

genre.memoire.h1: Free Memory Games and Hidden Object Games
genre.memoire.titre_seo: Free Memory Games | Free Micro Games
genre.memoire.description_seo: Free memory games: matching pairs, sound sequences and hidden object scenes from age 4. 24 games, some with online multiplayer. No account needed.
genre.memoire.intro:
Free memory games train two things at once: what you see and what you remember. Farm Memory Match is the classic matching game, with more animal cards at every level. In The Singing Seashells, you listen to a tune and play it back in the same order, and The Little Bistro's Orders shows each customer's dish for a few seconds before the bubble fades.

Hidden object games ask for sharp eyes instead. Hidden Treasures of the Reef sends you looking for animals before your air tank runs out, Where's the Phone? has you searching every room of a messy house, and The Four Seasons of the Orchard is a spot-the-difference game across the seasons.

Most of these games suit ages 4 to 9. The Hidden Car Park is a matching game you can play against real players online or against robots. Three games are meant for teens aged 13 and up, such as The Vigil of the Cursed Portraits, where you flip portraits in a dark manor while keeping your candles lit.

faq.q: Which memory games are best for a 4-year-old?
faq.r: Farm Memory Match, The Singing Seashells and The Little Bistro's Orders start at age 4, with only a few cards or notes to remember at first.

faq.q: Can two people play a matching game together?
faq.r: Yes: The Hidden Car Park pairs you with real players over the internet. With no connection, robots take the empty seats and the game goes on.

faq.q: Are these memory games really free?
faq.r: All of them are free to play from start to finish. Nothing is for sale inside the games.

faq.q: Can I play on an iPhone or a tablet?
faq.r: Yes, on iPhone, Android, tablets and computers. Flipping cards and spotting objects works with a fingertip or a mouse.

genre.quiz.titre_seo: Free Quiz Games | Free Micro Games
genre.quiz.description_seo: Free quiz games for kids aged 5 to 9: flags, planets, animal riddles, telling time. Ten trivia games, one with online multiplayer, and no sign-up at all.
genre.quiz.intro:
These quiz games for kids turn trivia into short rounds with pictures, sounds and riddles. Flags of the World covers all 193 countries, continent by continent, across 20 levels. The Grand Planet Tour asks you to line up the planets around the Sun and guess who is talking in the riddles. In What Time Is It?, you read a clock and pick the right time among four answers, from o'clock to the exact minute.

Riddles take over in The Riddle Safari, where you read Tiko's clue and find the animal hiding in the savanna or the jungle. The Riddle Market lets you answer picture riddles against robots or other players online. For the youngest, The Fine-Ears Orchestra is a listening quiz: drum or flute, high or low.

The games start at age 5 and go up to 9. Younger kids can team up with a grown-up who reads the questions aloud, and a wrong answer simply shows the right one.

faq.q: From what age can a child play these quizzes?
faq.r: The Fine-Ears Orchestra needs no reading and starts at 5. Flags of the World, Manga Quiz and the planet questions suit kids of 8 and 9.

faq.q: Is there a multiplayer quiz?
faq.r: The Riddle Market can be played online with other players. Offline, or when nobody else is around, robots fill the seats.

faq.q: Do I have to give an email address?
faq.r: No email, no password, no sign-up form. The quiz starts as soon as you tap Play.

faq.q: Can we take the quizzes on a trip without Wi-Fi?
faq.r: Open each quiz once at home with internet; it then stays on the phone or tablet and works in the car or on a plane.

genre.mots.h1: Free Word Games and Alphabet Games
genre.mots.titre_seo: Free Word Games | Free Micro Games
genre.mots.description_seo: Free word games for ages 4 to 9: pop letter balloons, spell words in zero gravity, shunt letter wagons. Nine alphabet and spelling games, no sign-up.
genre.mots.intro:
These free word games start with single letters and end with whole words. In Letter Balloons, a letter appears and you pop every balloon that carries it before they fly away. The Nest of the Alphabet Baby Dinos asks you to find the egg with the same letter as mama dino, and Letter Constellations has you join letter stars to trace space words. These alphabet games suit kids from age 4.

Spelling comes next. The Lost Words of the Orbital Station sends you after letters floating in zero gravity to rebuild a radio message, and The Mixed-Up Word Wagons, for ages 9 and up, makes you shunt letter wagons along the tracks until the word in the picture appears.

Good to know: four games on this page, including The Syllable Zoo and The Garden of Growing Letters, use French words. Their menus and instructions are in English, which makes them a gentle first contact with French spelling.

faq.q: What age are the alphabet games for?
faq.r: Letter Balloons, Letter Constellations and the baby dino nest work from age 4. The word wagons are harder and aimed at readers of 9.

faq.q: Are all the word games in English?
faq.r: Most are. Four of them spell French words, such as The Syllable Zoo; their buttons and rules are still shown in English.

faq.q: Is it free to play the spelling games?
faq.r: Yes, every word game here is free, and there is nothing to buy inside.

faq.q: Do the word games run offline?
faq.r: Once a game has been opened with a connection, it stays on the device. Letters and words then work with no internet.

genre.calcul.titre_seo: Free Math Games | Free Micro Games
genre.calcul.description_seo: Free math games from age 6: counting, giving change, times tables, exact sums. 11 games to play on a phone or PC, some online with friends. No account.
genre.calcul.intro:
These free math games hide numbers inside little stories. Count the Bus Passengers keeps track of who gets on and off the number 7 bus, a first counting game for 6-year-olds. In The Squirrels' Grocery Store, you add up the animals' shopping and give change in acorns. Times Table Race puts multiplication on a forest track: pick the right answer and the fox jumps the obstacle.

Exact totals are the heart of several games. Hoops of the Exact Score turns each basketball shot into a +3, −2 or ×2, and you must land on the scoreboard number. The Little Apprentice Wizard's Potions counts moon drops into a cauldron, and The Pots of the Gourmet Market is a weighing race you can play online against other players or robots.

Most of the page fits ages 6 to 10. Two strategy games with numbers, The Ration Raft and Raptor Ravine, are meant for teens of 13 and over.

faq.q: Which math game teaches the times tables?
faq.r: Times Table Race, from age 7, asks a multiplication question at every obstacle. Hoops of the Exact Score also mixes in ×2 shots.

faq.q: Can kids play math games together online?
faq.r: Three games have online seats: The Pots of the Gourmet Market, The Ration Raft and Raptor Ravine. Robots step in when no one else joins.

faq.q: Do these math games cost anything?
faq.r: No. They are free, with no in-game purchases and no account.

faq.q: Do the math games work on a tablet?
faq.r: Yes. Tap the answers on a tablet or phone, or use a mouse and keyboard on a computer.

genre.arcade.h1: Free Arcade Games and Reflex Games
genre.arcade.titre_seo: Free Arcade Games | Free Micro Games
genre.arcade.description_seo: Free arcade games that start in a second: catch apples, put out fires, dodge golems. 31 reflex games from age 4, on a phone or computer, with no sign-up.
genre.arcade.intro:
Arcade games are quick to learn and hard to put down. In Pony Apples, you slide the pony to catch apples and carrots falling from the sky. Plume Takes Flight guides a little bird home across 50 skies, and The Little Firefighters Brigade asks you to tap the flames in the village fast, then rescue the cats with the big ladder.

Reflex games get faster as you go. Quick Tap in the Forest is a whack-the-animal game where the hedgehog must be left alone, Fairground Ring Toss tests your aim with bottles and wooden ducks, and Stone Fists keeps you dodging and rolling around a mud arena. The Little Judokas’ Tatami teaches timing, breakfalls and respect across 10 belts.

The games start at age 4, and most stay under 9. Older players can try The Couriers of the Busy City, a delivery ride through traffic for ages 12 and up. One game on the page is for 13+.

faq.q: Are the arcade games easy for small children?
faq.r: Pony Apples, Plume Takes Flight and The Honking Parade start at 4 and need just one gesture. The pace picks up slowly from level to level.

faq.q: Can I play arcade games with a keyboard?
faq.r: Yes. Every game works by touch on a phone or tablet, and with the keyboard or mouse on a computer.

faq.q: Do I need to sign up to save my progress?
faq.r: No sign-up is needed. Your progress is kept on the device you play on.

faq.q: Will the reflex games work without internet?
faq.r: They will, after one first launch online. The game is then stored on the device and starts even in airplane mode.

genre.plateforme.h1: Free Platform Games and Jumping Games
genre.plateforme.titre_seo: Free Platform Games | Free Micro Games
genre.plateforme.description_seo: Free platform games: hop between moons, climb cliffs, jump across rooftops. 13 jumping games from age 5, on a phone, tablet or PC, with no sign-up needed.
genre.plateforme.intro:
Platform games are all about the next jump. The Little Snow Fox climbs a mountain to gather berries before the big snow, and The Little Pancake's Big Jump hops from pot to chopping board after escaping the frying pan. In Ball Journey, a 3D ball rolls from platform to platform up to the star, with checkpoint flags along the way.

Some jumping games add a twist. Lunette's Moon Hops gives every moon its own gravity, so each leap feels different. The Cliff Foal has you leaping over rolling rocks and stubborn goats to find a lost herd, and The Messenger of Old Rooftops, for ages 10 and up, mixes running, wall climbing and sliding down clotheslines.

Ages range from 5 to 10 for most of the page. Two platformers are made for teens: The Lighthouse of the Drowned, a climb up a storm-battered lighthouse, and The Night Junkyard Trial, a bike ride past crushers and magnet cranes.

faq.q: What age is right for these platformers?
faq.r: Little ones can start at 5 with The Little Snow Fox or the runaway pancake. The rooftop messenger suits 10, and two games are for 13+.

faq.q: How do you jump on a phone?
faq.r: Every platform game can be played with touch controls on a phone or tablet, and with the keyboard on a computer.

faq.q: Are the platform games free?
faq.r: Yes, all {n} are free, with no purchases inside and no account to create.

faq.q: Can I play platformers offline?
faq.r: Yes: launch the game once while connected, and the device keeps it. The levels then run without any network.

genre.course.titre_seo: Free Racing Games | Free Micro Games
genre.course.description_seo: Free racing games: pony derbies, tractor rallies, ski slaloms and sailboat regattas from age 5. 13 races, four with online multiplayer, and no account.
genre.course.intro:
These free racing games don't all happen on a road. The Great Pony Derby runs 60 races where you tap to the rhythm of the gallop and jump the rails. The Tractor Rally sends you through mud and rain against 3 rivals, and The Little Sailboat Regatta asks you to turn your sail with the wind to round the islands first. Snowflake Slalom is a ski race between blue and red gates.

Speed is not the only skill. Times Table Race is won with right answers, since each multiplication lets the fox jump an obstacle. The Baby Dino Race is a race to the volcano nest that you can play against real players online or against robots.

Most races suit ages 5 to 9. Four games on the page are for teens of 13 and up, like The Pit Wall: Night Championship, where you run a car team turn by turn, managing tires and pit stops.

faq.q: Can I race against my friends?
faq.r: The Baby Dino Race and three races for teens have online multiplayer. When there aren't enough players, robots join the starting line.

faq.q: Which racing games suit a 5-year-old?
faq.r: The Great Pony Derby, The Tractor Rally and The Little Sailboat Regatta all start at age 5, with simple taps and swipes.

faq.q: Do the online races need internet?
faq.r: Yes, racing real players needs a connection. Racing robots alone works offline once the game has been opened one time.

faq.q: Is there an account or a fee?
faq.r: Neither. The races are free and you can start without signing up.

genre.aventure.titre_seo: Free Adventure Games | Free Micro Games
genre.aventure.description_seo: Free adventure games: explore caves, raise creatures, climb peaks and break magic seals. 17 exploration games and RPGs from age 4, no sign-up needed.
genre.aventure.intro:
Adventure games give you a world to explore and a goal at the end of it. In Cube Lands, from age 4, you gather materials, craft tools and build a shelter. The Caves of Brumefer change every time you enter, with gems, keys and potions to collect on the way to the Guardian. Dinosaur Egg Island has you push logs and fix vine bridges to bring lost eggs back to their nests.

Older kids can go further. Fabulimo: The Lands of Aloria is a creature-raising RPG with 8 arena badges to win, The Spellbook of Seven Seals uses a deck of spell cards across 3 acts, and Silent Lands, for ages 12 and up, sends you mapping a mountain range ruled by beasts.

The page runs from age 4 to 12, plus two multiplayer adventures for teens: The Opaline Tower Heist and The Last Metro at 3:33 AM. Your progress is saved on the device, so a long quest can wait until tomorrow.

faq.q: Is there an adventure game for a 4-year-old?
faq.r: Cube Lands starts at 4. The Gingerbread Donkey's Rounds and The Little Snow Fox follow at 5, with short paths and few dangers.

faq.q: Do adventure games save my progress?
faq.r: Yes, the game remembers your last level on the device, and Continue takes you back there. No account is needed.

faq.q: Can I explore offline?
faq.r: After the first launch with internet, an adventure stays on your device. Solo quests then go on even without a network.

faq.q: Does it work on Android and iPhone?
faq.r: Yes, and on tablets and computers too. You explore with your finger on a touch screen or with the keyboard.

genre.strategie.h1: Free Strategy Games and Board Games
genre.strategie.titre_seo: Free Strategy Games | Free Micro Games
genre.strategie.description_seo: Free strategy games: tower defense, card duels, Roman board games and city building. 37 games from age 6, 18 with online multiplayer. No account at all.
genre.strategie.intro:
Strategy games reward the player who thinks one move ahead. Firefly Fortress is a tower defense game for ages 6 and up: place towers of light along the path to stop the Shadowlings for 15 levels. In Farmyard Pens, you lay one fence per turn to close pens and fill the meadow with your animals, against robots or real players online. Ludus Coriovalli brings back an old Roman board game carved in stone.

Cards and planning come later. The Battle of the Pirate Chests is a card game across 20 islands, MapWorld Conquest lets you grow a kingdom in real time, and Run Your City, for ages 12 and up, puts you in the mayor's seat with a budget to watch.

This is the page with the most multiplayer games: 18 of them have online seats. Fourteen are for teens of 13 and over, such as Flight from the Hanging Wood or Station Hades: Oxygen Running Out, where tension and a little fear are part of the plan.

faq.q: Which strategy games can kids of 6 play?
faq.r: Firefly Fortress, Farmyard Pens, The Scribble Army and The Baby Dino Race start at 6, with simple turns and clear goals.

faq.q: How does online multiplayer work here?
faq.r: Choose to play online and you join a waiting room. Robots fill the empty seats, and the first player there launches the match.

faq.q: Can I play board games without internet?
faq.r: Yes, against robots. Open the game once online so it is stored; matches with other people still need a connection.

faq.q: Do strategy games need an account?
faq.r: No. Matches are free and you never have to create an account or share an email.

genre.simulation.titre_seo: Free Simulation Games | Free Micro Games
genre.simulation.description_seo: Free simulation games: run a vet's office, a bakery, a garage or a whole city. 17 care and management games from age 4, some online. No sign-up needed.
genre.simulation.intro:
In simulation games, you take on a job and keep things running. Touch Grooming lets 4-year-olds clean a muddy pony with real finger moves until it wins a ribbon. The Vet's Office has you listen to hearts, take temperatures and find the right care for kittens, rabbits and foals. In The Baby Turtle Nursery, you help hatchlings reach the sea and look after the tired ones.

Management games add time and money. The Little Neighborhood Baker asks you to knead, bake and serve customers before they get impatient, The Little Mechanic's Garage fixes the village's flat tires and empty tanks, and Run Your City, for ages 12 and up, puts a whole town and its budget in your hands.

Most of the page suits ages 4 to 9. Five games are for teens of 13 and over, among them The Anomaly Hospital and The Revenants' Boarding House, a haunted hotel run with other players online.

faq.q: Are there pet care games for young kids?
faq.r: Yes: Touch Grooming starts at 4, and The Vet's Office and The Baby Turtle Nursery at 5 and 6. Caring for animals is the whole game.

faq.q: Is it free to run the bakery or the city?
faq.r: Every simulation is free, from the first customer to the last level, with no in-game shop.

faq.q: Can I play simulations on a phone?
faq.r: Yes. Tapping, rubbing and dragging work on any touch screen, and a mouse does the job on a computer.

faq.q: Can the haunted hotel be played with friends?
faq.r: The Revenants' Boarding House and three other teen games have online seats. Robots take over any role left empty.

genre.creation.h1: Free Creative Games: Dress Up, Coloring and Building
genre.creation.titre_seo: Free Creative Games | Free Micro Games
genre.creation.description_seo: Free creative games from age 4: dress up a pony, paint fairy tales, design carnival costumes, build crazy machines. 11 games, no sign-up, offline too.
genre.creation.intro:
Creative games leave room for your own ideas. Pony Dress-Up lets you pick a coat, a mane and an outfit, then choose a setting for your pony. In The Grand Carnival Costumes, you dress the dancers with hats, masks and capes the way their bubbles show, then send them down the parade. The Magic Paintbrush of Fairy Tales is a coloring game where mixing paints wakes up the dragon and the castle.

Building games come next. Dino Valley Cabins asks you to put up cabins of logs and leaves before the storm, Beaver the Bridge Builder checks whether your bridge holds when the bear crosses, and The Crazy Contraption Workshop, for ages 10 and up, lets you build vehicles with springs, propellers and floats and watch them drive off alone.

The page goes from age 4 to 12. Cube Lands and Run Your City round it out, one with a world of cubes, the other with a whole town to design.

faq.q: What age are the dress up and coloring games for?
faq.r: Pony Dress-Up, The Grand Carnival Costumes and the fairy tale paintbrush start at 4. The contraption workshop is for 10 and up.

faq.q: Is anything for sale in the creative games?
faq.r: No. Every outfit, color and building piece is free to use.

faq.q: Can kids play these creative games offline?
faq.r: Yes, once a game has loaded one time with internet. The paints, costumes and blocks are then available without a network.

faq.q: Can I build and color on a tablet?
faq.r: Tablets suit these games well, and so do phones. On a computer, you drag and click with the mouse.

genre.musique.h1: Free Music Games and Rhythm Games
genre.musique.titre_seo: Free Music Games | Free Micro Games
genre.musique.description_seo: Free music games: tap to the beat with frogs, ponies and dinosaurs, replay melodies, play rhythm tennis. 14 rhythm games from age 4, and no sign-up.
genre.musique.intro:
These music games ask you to listen as much as to look. In The Frog Choir, you tap the frogs at the right moment so they sing the pond's melody. The Carousel of Musical Ponies plays your song as the glowing ponies pass under the golden lantern, and The Honking Parade makes each vehicle honk on the beat. They all work from age 4 or 5.

Some rhythm games mix music with other skills. The Rhythm Rally Court is tennis on the beat, The Little Acrobats' Rhythmic Gym guides a gymnast through her routine, and The Dancing Kitchen turns chopping and flipping into a song. The Singing Planets and The Caravan of Melodies ask you to replay tunes from memory.

Sound matters here, so headphones help on a bus. One game is for teens of 13 and up: The Crypt Choir, a multiplayer game where you replay a stone organ's chant and add your own note.

faq.q: Can a 4-year-old play the rhythm games?
faq.r: Yes. The Carousel of Musical Ponies, The Singing Seashells and The Baby Animal Marching Band start at 4 and need one tap at a time.

faq.q: Are the music games free to play?
faq.r: All {n} are free. You don't buy songs or levels.

faq.q: Can we play them offline in the car?
faq.r: Yes. Open each game once while connected; it stays on the phone, sound included, and plays without internet.

faq.q: Is there a music game for several players?
faq.r: The Crypt Choir, for 13 and up, can be played online with other people. On your own, robots sing the other parts.

univers.animaux.titre_seo: Free Animal Games | Free Micro Games
univers.animaux.description_seo: Free animal games: farm memory, vet care, baby turtles, a mouse maze and a hedgehog crossing. 20 games from age 4, one online. Play on a phone or PC.
univers.animaux.intro:
Farm animals, pets and wild creatures star in these free animal games. Farm Memory Match is a first matching game for 4-year-olds, and Farmyard Pens has you fence in your animals against robots or real players online. At The Vet's Office, you check heartbeats and temperatures to heal kittens, rabbits and turtles. In The Baby Turtle Nursery, you guide hatchlings to the sea and shoo away the gulls.

Wild animals have their own games. The Riddle Safari hides animals in the savanna, on the pack ice and in the jungle. Beaver the Bridge Builder tests your bridges with a rabbit and a bear, and The Hedgehog Crossing, for ages 9 and up, is a step-by-step puzzle to cross a garden without bumping into the sleeping dog.

Nearly every game on the page suits ages 4 to 9. The Anomaly Hospital, an animal hospital on a creepy night shift, is the one game for teens of 13 and over.

faq.q: What are the best animal games for preschoolers?
faq.r: Farm Memory Match, Plume Takes Flight and The Baby Animal Marching Band are made for 4-year-olds. The mouse maze and animal puzzles follow at 5.

faq.q: Can we play the farm game with other people?
faq.r: Farmyard Pens has an online mode with real players. With no one around or no network, you play the same game against robots.

faq.q: Do these animal games ask for an email?
faq.r: Never. You don't create an account, and the games are free.

faq.q: Do animal games work on a phone?
faq.r: Yes, on Android phones, iPhones and tablets, and also on a computer with a mouse.

univers.chevaux.h1: Free Horse Games and Pony Games
univers.chevaux.titre_seo: Free Horse Games | Free Micro Games
univers.chevaux.description_seo: Free horse games: dress up and groom your pony, race in the derby, solve horse sudoku. 12 pony games from age 4, on a phone or tablet, with no sign-up.
univers.chevaux.intro:
These free horse games cover everything from grooming to racing. With Touch Grooming, you rub a muddy pony's coat, pick its hooves and comb its mane until it is spotless. Pony Dress-Up lets you choose a coat, a mane and a setting, and The Carousel of Musical Ponies is a rhythm game for ages 4 and up.

Pony riding takes over in The Great Pony Derby, with 60 races over hurdles and big rails, tapping in time with the hooves. Hazel the Pony's Great Trek and The Cliff Foal are adventures across maps and mountain meadows. The Wild Pony Herd asks you to lead a head mare and her herd to shelter before nightfall.

For older riders, aged 8 to 10, Horse Sudoku swaps numbers for horses, Feeding Time at Linden Tree Stables is about giving every horse its exact ration, and The Mixed-Up Stable Stalls is a sliding puzzle in the stable aisle.

faq.q: Which horse games suit a 4-year-old?
faq.r: Pony Dress-Up, Touch Grooming, Pony Apples and the musical carousel all start at 4. The derby follows at 5.

faq.q: Are the pony games free?
faq.r: Yes, all {n} horse games are free, with nothing to buy for your pony.

faq.q: Can we play the horse games offline?
faq.r: Yes. Once a horse game has been opened with internet, it stays on the device and you can ride or groom without a connection.

faq.q: Do the horse games run on a tablet?
faq.r: They run on tablets, Android phones, iPhones and computers. Grooming is especially fun with a fingertip.

univers.dinosaures.titre_seo: Free Dinosaur Games | Free Micro Games
univers.dinosaures.description_seo: Free dinosaur games: hatch alphabet eggs, dig up fossils, race baby dinos and glide with a pterodactyl. 11 dino games from age 4, some of them online.
univers.dinosaures.intro:
These free dinosaur games go from the egg to the fossil. In The Nest of the Alphabet Baby Dinos, you tap the egg with the right letter to hatch mama dino's baby. The Great Dinosaur Parade is a rhythm game with a giant drum, and Dino Valley Cabins asks you to build shelters before the storm. All three start at age 4 or 5.

Footprints in the Dinosaur Valley is a memory game: the herd crosses the mud and you place each dino on its tracks, in order. The Baby Dino Race can be played against robots or real players online. The Museum of Mystery Fossils, for ages 8 and up, has you brush away sand and fill display cases with dinosaur bones, and The Little Pterodactyl and the Sleeping Volcanoes is a platform game across fern forests and glaciers.

Two dino games are for teens of 13 and over, both played online: Raptor Ravine and The Last Days of the Crater.

faq.q: What is a good dino game for a preschooler?
faq.r: Try The Nest of the Alphabet Baby Dinos from age 4, or The Great Dinosaur Parade from 5. Both use one simple tap.

faq.q: Can my kids race baby dinos together?
faq.r: Yes, The Baby Dino Race has online seats for real players. Robots fill in the rest, and solo races work offline.

faq.q: Do I have to register?
faq.r: No registration and no email. Choose a dinosaur game and play.

faq.q: Can we play dinosaur games on a phone?
faq.r: Yes, on Android phones, iPhones and tablets, or on a computer with a keyboard and mouse.

univers.ocean.h1: Free Ocean Games and Pirate Games
univers.ocean.titre_seo: Free Ocean Games | Free Micro Games
univers.ocean.description_seo: Free ocean games: steer a submarine, find reef animals, win pirate gold, race sailboats. 11 sea and pirate games from age 4, no sign-up, and offline too.
univers.ocean.intro:
These free ocean games take you above and below the waves. The Little Submarine of the Blue Caves steers Bubble through 20 underwater caves to bring back lost pearls. Hidden Treasures of the Reef is a hidden object game where you spot sea animals before your air runs out, and The Singing Seashells, for ages 4 and up, asks you to replay the shells' song.

Pirates and sailors get their turn. The Battle of the Pirate Chests is a card game against 20 pirate captains, The Little Sailboat Regatta is a race around the islands with the wind in your sail, and Sandcastles vs the Tide has you dig moats and build walls, wave after wave. In The Gannet's Great Dives, a seabird plunges after schools of fish.

The Treasure Map of Words uses French words. Two games are for teens: The Lighthouse of the Drowned and The Ration Raft, a survival game for several players online.

faq.q: From what age are the sea games?
faq.r: The Singing Seashells is for 4 and up, the reef and regatta games for 5. The pirate card battle and the sandcastles are aimed at 8.

faq.q: Can several players share a boat online?
faq.r: The Ration Raft, for teens, seats several castaways online. Without a connection, robots play the other castaways.

faq.q: Are the ocean games free?
faq.r: Yes, the submarine, the regatta and the pirate battles are all free, with no purchases.

faq.q: Will the sea games work at the beach without Wi-Fi?
faq.r: Yes, if you open them once beforehand with internet. They stay saved on the phone or tablet.

univers.nature.h1: Free Nature Games: Gardens and Seasons
univers.nature.titre_seo: Free Nature Games | Free Micro Games
univers.nature.description_seo: Free nature games: grow a garden, ski a slalom, pack holiday gifts, explore the forest with a magnifier. 22 seasonal games for ages 4 to 12, no sign-up.
univers.nature.intro:
These free nature games follow the seasons. The Four Seasons of the Orchard is a spot-the-difference game where snow, flowers and fruit must match the time of year. In Garden Express, you plant, water and harvest vegetables, then sell them at the market. The Little Naturalist's Notebook sends you to the forest, the pond and the beach with a magnifying glass to collect tracks, feathers and bird songs.

Winter has its own games. Snowflake Slalom is a ski race between gates, The Little Snow Fox climbs a mountain before the big snow, and Sleigh Gift Packing, a holiday puzzle, asks you to fit presents of every shape into the sleigh. Butterfly Flight crosses the countryside from flower to flower.

The page runs from age 4 to 12, with Silent Lands and Climbing the Peak of the Four Winds for the oldest. One game here, The Garden of Growing Letters, spells French words.

faq.q: Which nature games are for the youngest?
faq.r: The orchard seasons game, Plume Takes Flight and Cube Lands start at 4. The frog choir and the snow fox follow at 5.

faq.q: Can we play the garden games offline?
faq.r: After opening a game once online, it is kept on the device. Gardening, skiing and gift packing then work with no internet.

faq.q: Do the seasonal games need a login?
faq.r: No login and no account. They're free and start right away.

faq.q: Do they work on a phone?
faq.r: Yes, by touch on phones and tablets, and with a mouse or keyboard on a computer.

univers.fantasy.h1: Free Magic Games: Wizards, Fairies and Monsters
univers.fantasy.titre_seo: Free Magic Games | Free Micro Games
univers.fantasy.description_seo: Free magic games: brew potions, cast card spells, relight fairy lanterns, raise creatures. 18 fantasy and monster games from age 4, a few made for teens.
univers.fantasy.intro:
Wizards, fairies and friendly monsters fill these free magic games. In The Little Apprentice Wizard's Potions, you pour the exact number of moon drops into a cauldron while a cat knocks the bottles over. Fairy Twiggy's Lantern flies through a sleeping forest to relight lanterns that make bridges appear. Elemental Powers mixes fire, water, earth and air to help a village.

Fantasy games for older kids go further. The Spellbook of Seven Seals is a card game where your deck grows across 3 acts, Fabulimo: The Lands of Aloria lets you catch and raise made-up creatures, and The Caves of Brumefer changes its misty tunnels every time you return. For the youngest, The Magic Paintbrush of Fairy Tales brings a fairy tale book back to color.

Most of the page suits ages 4 to 12. Five monster games are for teens of 13 and up, from The Revenants' Boarding House to The Lighthouse of the Drowned; four of them can be played online with other people.

faq.q: Which magic games are fine for young children?
faq.r: The fairy tale paintbrush and Cube Lands start at 4; the fairy lantern and the potions at 7 and 8. The scarier games are marked 13+.

faq.q: Can I play the haunted games with friends?
faq.r: Four teen games, like The Crypt Choir and The Vigil of the Cursed Portraits, have online seats. Robots take the places nobody fills.

faq.q: Do the magic games cost anything?
faq.r: Nothing. Spells, potions and cards are all free, without an account.

faq.q: Can I play fantasy games offline?
faq.r: Yes, solo. Load the game once with internet and it stays on the device; online matches need a network.

univers.espace.h1: Free Space Games: Planets, Rockets and Robots
univers.espace.titre_seo: Free Space Games | Free Micro Games
univers.espace.description_seo: Free space games: guide Robot Max, tour the planets, fly a space taxi, build a robot. 15 planet and robot games from age 4, some online, and no sign-up.
univers.espace.intro:
These free space games go from the robot workshop to the edge of the solar system. Robot Max, for ages 4 and up, guides a little robot through 24 factory mazes. In Letter Constellations, you join letter stars to trace space words, and The Grand Planet Tour asks you to put the planets in order around the Sun.

Rockets and robots keep older kids busy. The Little Aliens' Space Taxi is about landing gently on tiny planets, Lunette's Moon Hops gives each moon its own gravity, and The Tinkered Robot Workshop lets you build a robot piece by piece and test it on wobbly bridges. Pixel, the Lost Robot crosses 20 pixel rooms to find the parts of his rocket.

Most games here suit ages 4 to 9; Orbit Turrets, a station defense game, is for 12 and up. Four games are for teens of 13 and over, such as Station Hades: Oxygen Running Out, a multiplayer survival game on a failing space station.

faq.q: What age are the planet games for?
faq.r: Robot Max and Letter Constellations start at 4. The planet tour, the moon hops and the robot workshop are made for 7 and up.

faq.q: Are there space games for several players?
faq.r: Yes, three teen games, including The Black Well Race, have online seats. When nobody else joins, robots pilot the other ships.

faq.q: Do space games work on a tablet?
faq.r: They do, as well as on Android phones, iPhones and computers, with touch or keyboard controls.

faq.q: Is it free to explore the planets?
faq.r: Yes. Every planet and robot game is free, with no account to make.

univers.monde.h1: Free Geography Games and History Games
univers.monde.titre_seo: Free Geography Games | Free Micro Games
univers.monde.description_seo: Free geography games: learn 193 flags, ride a train around the world, conquer a map, play a Roman board game. 13 history games from age 4, no account.
univers.monde.intro:
These free geography games take you around the world and back in time. Flags of the World covers the flags of all 193 countries, continent by continent, in 20 levels. The Little Round-the-World Train drives a locomotive from country to country, braking before each bend. In MapWorld Conquest, for ages 10 and up, you grow a kingdom across a map in real time.

History games bring the past closer. Secrets of the Golden Scarab opens the doors of a pyramid with hieroglyph sequences. Ludus Coriovalli is a board game carved on Roman stone, The Apprentice of Great Inventions restarts 20 machines from history, from the ancient potter to the first aviator, and The Messenger of Old Rooftops runs from Rome to the first hot-air balloons.

The page starts at age 4 with The Grand Carnival Costumes and goes up to 13+ with The Doctors of the Walled City, a multiplayer game set in 1348.

faq.q: At what age can kids learn flags here?
faq.r: Flags of the World is aimed at 8 and up. Younger players can start with the scarab's pyramid at 6 or the carnival costumes at 4.

faq.q: Do the history games need an account?
faq.r: No. All {n} games are free and open without signing up.

faq.q: Can we play the geography games offline?
faq.r: Yes. After a first launch with internet, flags and maps stay on the device for later.

faq.q: Do the map games work on a phone?
faq.r: Yes, on phones and tablets by touch, and on a computer with a mouse.

univers.ville.h1: Free Jobs Games: Firefighters, Bakers and Mechanics
univers.ville.titre_seo: Free Jobs Games | Free Micro Games
univers.ville.description_seo: Free jobs games: put out fires, bake bread, fix cars, deliver mail, run a city. 17 games about work and city life from age 4, on phone or PC, no sign-up.
univers.ville.intro:
In these free jobs games, you try out a different job in every game. The Little Mail Carrier's Round asks 4-year-olds to remember doors, shutters and cats in windows to deliver each letter. The Little Firefighters Brigade sprays flames and rescues cats with the big ladder, and The Little Neighborhood Baker kneads dough, bakes golden loaves and serves the line of customers.

City life goes on. Count the Bus Passengers puts you behind the wheel of the number 7 bus, The Little Mechanic's Garage fixes flat tires and muddy cars, and The Little Skyscraper Window Washer climbs from ledge to ledge with a sponge. At The Vet's Office, the patients are kittens and foals.

Ages 4 to 9 cover most of the page. Run Your City and The Couriers of the Busy City are for 12 and up, and The Opaline Tower Heist, a multiplayer game for teens, is the only 13+ game here.

faq.q: Which jobs games suit kids of 4 or 5?
faq.r: The mail carrier's round starts at 4; the vet, the window washer and the ring toss stall at 5. Firefighters and bakers come at 6.

faq.q: Are the city games free?
faq.r: Yes, every job on this page is free to try, with no purchases.

faq.q: Can we play them without internet?
faq.r: Yes. Once loaded with internet, each game stays on your device and runs offline.

faq.q: Do I need to sign up?
faq.r: No. There's no account and no email address: just pick a job and play.

univers.vehicules.h1: Free Vehicle Games: Cars, Trucks, Tractors and Trains
univers.vehicules.titre_seo: Free Vehicle Games | Free Micro Games
univers.vehicules.description_seo: Free vehicle games: race a tractor, drive a train around the world, fix cars, honk in a parade. 12 car, truck and train games from age 4, some online.
univers.vehicules.intro:
Tractors, buses, trains and fire trucks all have a seat in these free vehicle games. The Honking Parade, for ages 4 and up, makes each vehicle honk on the beat as it rolls under the arch. In The Tractor Rally, you race through mud and rain against 3 rivals. Count the Bus Passengers keeps track of riders on the number 7 bus.

Trains and garages come next. The Little Round-the-World Train asks you to speed up, brake before the bends and stop right at the station. The Little Mechanic's Garage fixes flat tires and empty tanks, while builders from age 10 assemble wheels, springs and propellers into a homemade car in The Crazy Contraption Workshop. The Hidden Car Park is a matching game you can play online with real players.

Three games here are for teens, including The Pit Wall: Night Championship, a racing team game played turn by turn.

faq.q: What vehicle game is best for a 4-year-old?
faq.r: The Honking Parade starts at 4 and needs one tap per vehicle. The Tractor Rally follows at 5.

faq.q: Can I play the car games with other people?
faq.r: The Hidden Car Park and two teen games have online multiplayer. Robots stand in when there aren't enough players.

faq.q: Do the truck and train games work offline?
faq.r: Yes, after one launch with internet. Online matches with other players still need a connection.

faq.q: Can we play on a phone?
faq.r: Yes, on Android phones, iPhones, tablets and computers, by touch or with the keyboard.

univers.sport.h1: Free Sports Games: Judo, Gym, Basketball and Skiing
univers.sport.titre_seo: Free Sports Games | Free Micro Games
univers.sport.description_seo: Free sports games: judo belts, rhythmic gym, basketball sums, ski slaloms and rock climbing. 11 games for young athletes from age 5, and no sign-up.
univers.sport.intro:
These free sports games each pick a different sport. The Little Judokas’ Tatami teaches bows, breakfalls and timing across 10 belts, with respect for your partner. The Little Acrobats' Rhythmic Gym, from age 5, guides Lila through cartwheels, balances and hoops to the music. The Rhythm Rally Court is tennis on the beat, from grass court to beach.

Some games mix sport and thinking. Hoops of the Exact Score turns every basketball shot into a little sum. The Little Coach's Tactics Board, for ages 9 and up, has you plan passes all the way to the goal, and Climbing the Peak of the Four Winds asks 12-year-olds to manage a rope team's energy on the way to the summit. Snowflake Slalom and Slide Race are about pure speed.

The page runs from age 5 to 12, plus one racing team game for teens played online.

faq.q: What age are the sports games for?
faq.r: The gym and tennis games start at 5 or 6, judo at 6. Tactics and mountain climbing are for 9 and 12.

faq.q: Is there an online sports game?
faq.r: The Pit Wall: Night Championship, for 13 and up, has online multiplayer. Played alone, it pits you against robot teams and works offline.

faq.q: Are the sports games free?
faq.r: Yes, judo, gym, basketball and skiing are all free, with no account needed.

faq.q: Can I play sports games on a phone?
faq.r: Yes. Every sport is playable by touch on a phone or tablet, and with the keyboard on a computer.

univers.cuisine.h1: Free Cooking Games: Baking, Pizza and Restaurants
univers.cuisine.titre_seo: Free Cooking Games | Free Micro Games
univers.cuisine.description_seo: Free cooking games: bake cloud cakes, serve bistro orders, flip pancakes, win a pizza contest. 11 kitchen and restaurant games from age 4, some online.
univers.cuisine.intro:
These free cooking games go from the bakery to the busy restaurant. The Little Bistro's Orders, for ages 4 and up, shows each customer's dish in a fading bubble that you must remember. The Cloud Bakery asks you to mix, bake and decorate the cakes the birds draw, and The Little Pancake's Big Jump is a platform game starring a runaway pancake.

Restaurant games add speed and rules. The Dancing Kitchen turns chopping and flipping into music, The Banquet of Picky Guests asks you to seat animals and serve the dish each one wants, and The Pizza Chef Contest, for ages 10 and up, is a race on a conveyor belt against robots or real players online. The Pots of the Gourmet Market and The Riddle Market also have online seats.

Ages run from 4 to 10. One game, The Canteen's Alphabet Soup, spells vegetable names in French.

faq.q: Which cooking games are for little kids?
faq.r: The bistro orders start at 4; the cloud bakery, the harvest feast and the pancake jump at 5.

faq.q: Can we cook against other players?
faq.r: Three games, including The Pizza Chef Contest, have online multiplayer. Robot cooks take the free places.

faq.q: Are the cooking games free?
faq.r: Yes. Recipes, ovens and pizzas cost nothing, and no sign-up is needed.

faq.q: Can we play the restaurant games offline?
faq.r: Yes, against robots, once the game has been opened with internet. Online contests need a connection.

age.4-6.titre_seo: Free Games for Kids Ages 4-6 | Free Micro Games
age.4-6.description_seo: Free games for kids ages 4-6: 78 preschool and kindergarten games with letters, animals, ponies and music. Little to read, easy by touch, no sign-up.
age.4-6.intro:
This page gathers {n} free games for kids ages 4-6, with very little to read. Preschool games like Farm Memory Match, The Carousel of Musical Ponies and Pony Apples need one gesture: flip a card, tap on the beat, slide to catch. Letter Balloons and The Nest of the Alphabet Baby Dinos help kindergarten kids recognize letters, and The Magic Necklace asks them to finish a row of beads.

At 5 and 6, the games get a little longer. The Vet's Office, The Mouse Maze and The Little Snow Fox add a goal to reach, and Count the Bus Passengers or What Time Is It? bring first numbers and clocks. Three games, like Farmyard Pens and The Baby Dino Race, can be played online with real players or against robots.

Levels start easy, and the game remembers where your child stopped. A few word games spell French words, which is noted on their page.

faq.q: Can my 4-year-old play alone?
faq.r: Many can. The first levels are gentle and most rules fit in a few words on screen, though a grown-up nearby helps at the start.

faq.q: Are these kindergarten games free?
faq.r: Yes, all {n} are free to play, and nothing inside can be bought.

faq.q: Will my child need an account?
faq.r: No. There's no account and no email, and progress stays on the device.

faq.q: Can we play on a phone in the car?
faq.r: Yes. Open the games once with internet; they stay on the phone and play offline on the road.

age.7-9.titre_seo: Free Games for Kids Ages 7-9 | Free Micro Games
age.7-9.description_seo: Free games for kids ages 7-9: times tables, flags, riddles, card battles and robot workshops. 47 games for 8 year olds and up, no account, offline too.
age.7-9.intro:
Between 7 and 9, kids read on their own and like a real challenge. These {n} free games for kids ages 7-9 make the most of it. Times Table Race and The Squirrels' Grocery Store turn math into a race and a shop till. Flags of the World and The Grand Planet Tour bring geography and space into short quizzes.

Bigger projects are waiting too. In The Tinkered Robot Workshop, you build a robot and test it on wobbly bridges. Fabulimo: The Lands of Aloria is a creature-raising adventure with 8 arena badges, and The Battle of the Pirate Chests a card game across 20 islands. For 8 year olds who like logic, Horse Sudoku and The Hedgehog Crossing take some thought.

Two games have online multiplayer: The Pots of the Gourmet Market and The Riddle Market, where robots fill any empty places. One word game, The Canteen's Alphabet Soup, uses French words.

faq.q: Are these games too hard for a 7-year-old?
faq.r: Games marked 7+ start gently, like Lunette's Moon Hops or Snowflake Slalom. The 9+ games, such as The Hedgehog Crossing, ask for more planning.

faq.q: Is it free to play with friends online?
faq.r: Yes. The two multiplayer games are free like the rest, and robots replace missing players.

faq.q: Do kids need an email address?
faq.r: No email is ever asked. Children just choose a game and play.

faq.q: Can they play offline on a tablet?
faq.r: Yes. A game opened once with internet stays on the tablet and keeps working offline, alone or against robots.

age.10-12.titre_seo: Free Games for Kids Ages 10-12 | Free Micro Games
age.10-12.description_seo: Free games for kids ages 10-12: city building, map conquest, Roman board games, climbing and space defense. 13 games for tweens, and no sign-up at all.
age.10-12.intro:
Tweens want games with depth, and these {n} free games for kids ages 10-12 have plenty. Run Your City makes you mayor, balancing homes, schools, parks and the treasury. MapWorld Conquest sends spearmen, riders and catapults across a map in real time, and Orbit Turrets asks you to defend a space station against pirate drones while managing credits.

Others are about careful thinking. King Barnaby's Scales is a weight puzzle in a castle, The Mixed-Up Stable Stalls a sliding puzzle to solve in as few moves as possible, and Ludus Coriovalli a Roman board game where trapped pieces turn into statues. Silent Lands, a story of trackers and beasts in the mountains, rewards patience.

The Pizza Chef Contest is the multiplayer game of the page: five chefs on one conveyor belt, online or with robots. For players ready for more thrills, the 13+ page is one step up.

faq.q: Are these games right for an 11-year-old?
faq.r: Yes. Games marked 10+ and 12+ ask for strategy and planning but stay suitable for tweens, without the scares of the teen games.

faq.q: Do the strategy games cost money?
faq.r: No. City building, conquest and space defense are free, with no in-game purchases.

faq.q: Is an account needed to save a city?
faq.r: No account. Your progress is saved on the device you play on.

faq.q: Do these games run on a computer?
faq.r: Yes, on computers with a keyboard and mouse, and on phones and tablets by touch.

age.13+.h1: Free Games for Teens: Horror, Suspense and Thrills
age.13+.titre_seo: Free Games for Teens | Free Micro Games
age.13+.description_seo: Free games for teens: 19 scary games full of suspense, from haunted manors to a ghost metro at 3:33 AM. 14 can be played online with friends. No sign-up.
age.13+.intro:
These free games for teens are made for players aged 13 and up who like a good scare. In The Last Metro at 3:33 AM, you search a ghost train for a ticket before the faceless Conductor catches you. The Vigil of the Cursed Portraits is a matching game in an abandoned manor, where your candles must stay lit. The Lighthouse of the Drowned is a climb up 20 storm-battered floors with a lantern running out of oil.

Not every game is horror. The Opaline Tower Heist is a stealth game with four rival thieves, The Pit Wall: Night Championship a turn-by-turn racing team manager, and Nova Dominion a real-time space strategy game over 30 missions.

Fourteen of these scary games can be played online with other players, and robots take the empty seats. The thrills come from tension and suspense, never from gore. These games stay out of the home page's new and trending rows, so younger kids don't land on them by accident.

faq.q: Why are these games marked 13+?
faq.r: They play with fear, suspense and dark settings like haunted hotels and drifting ships. That's why they are kept for teens.

faq.q: Can I play horror games with my friends?
faq.r: Yes, 14 of them have online multiplayer, and friends can join the same match. Robots fill the seats nobody takes.

faq.q: Do the scary games work offline?
faq.r: Solo, yes: after one launch online, you play against robots without a network. Matches with real players need internet.

faq.q: Do I need an account?
faq.r: No. Everything is free and you play without an account or email.
